topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I ain't never much cared for attics. Too many shadows, too many secrets hiding up there where the light can't reach. Found a box today, or rather, it found me. Old stuff, relics from the last bunch to call this place home. Photographs, papers, a dusty old pocket watch that's stopped ticking. Thought about tossing it all, clean slate and all that. But something held me back. Maybe it's the weight of the past pressing down, or maybe it's just the way the world keeps turning over, leaving traces behind. Figured I'd hold onto it for a bit, see if I can track down the rightful owners. Just a hunch, but it feels like the right thing to do. Even if it means digging through more than just old boxes.
